caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a rectangular wooden case featuring natural brown wood grain patterns. The clock has a prominent, arched bonnet top with simple decorative moldings. The clock face is circular with large black Roman numerals and black clock hands, and it is surrounded by a pale area adorned with small, delicate floral designs. Below the clock face, within a glass-paned door, a brass pendulum can be seen. The lower part of the clock case includes a solid wood panel with beveled edges, and the base is wider with a stepped rectangular shape matching the color and wood grain of the upper parts. The clock stands alone against a plain, light beige background.
title: Clock
